changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from AssetType where Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and Name = 'Data Classification' and class=9) begin declare @insertedList table(assetTypeId bigint, objectID bigint) declare @assetTypeId bigint, @objectID bigint
insert into [AssetType] (Name, Class, DisplayFormat, [Object], Uid) output inserted.ID, inserted.ObjectID into @insertedList values ('Data Classification', 9, '{Code}', 'ReferenceItemType', NEWID())
select top 1 @assetTypeId=assetTypeID, @objectID=objectID from @insertedList
if not exists (select 1 from FieldType where Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and assetTypeId=@assetTypeId and Name = 'Description') begin insert into FieldType (Name, [FriendlyName], [Type], [Object], [objectid], [assetTypeId], [IsRequired], [IsListable], [IsEditable]) VALUES ('Description', 'Description', 'Text', 'ReferenceItemType', @objectID, @assetTypeId, 0, 1, 1) end if not exists (select 1 from FieldType where Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and assetTypeId=@assetTypeId and Name = 'ProfileLevel') begin insert into FieldType (Name, [FriendlyName], [Type], [Object], [objectid], [assetTypeId], [IsRequired], [IsListable], [IsEditable]) VALUES ('ProfileLevel', 'Profile Level', 'Text', 'ReferenceItemType', @objectID, @assetTypeId, 0, 1, 1) end
insert into asset (AssetTypeID, Object, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, Code, Color) values (@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Unclassified', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Stone'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Sensitive', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Amber'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Public', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Grass'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Confidential', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Blush'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Proprietary', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Sunshine'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Secret', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Burgundy'), 0)) ,(@assetTypeId, 'ReferenceItem', GETDATE(), 0, 'Top Secret', COALESCE((select top 1 ID from Color where [name] = 'Ebony'), 0)) end
